audience: fraud and security analysts who investigate login and sign-up events in Castle

useCases.title: Find which IPs, devices or countries drive a spike
useCases.text: The AI reads the event fields, then groups matching events by IP, device or country. You see which values dominate, for example after a burst of failed logins.

useCases.title: Review recent logins, sign-ups and their risk verdicts
useCases.text: The AI searches the security event stream for logins, registrations and transactions and shows each event with its risk verdict, so you can follow one device or user.

useCases.title: Review what is on an allow or deny list
useCases.text: The AI finds the lists in the environment, shows their field definitions, counts the entries and searches the blocked IPs, emails or device ids a list holds.

useCases.title: Add an entry to a list or change its comment
useCases.text: The AI adds an IP, email or other value to a list, for example to block it, or edits the comment on an entry. Adding an entry changes live policy behaviour.

useCases.title: Archive or restore a list entry
useCases.text: The AI archives an entry so it stops matching, or restores an archived entry so it matches again. You can find the entry first by searching the list.
